final_user_goal: Materialize official Primary evidence bytes only when a downstream Evidence Bundle actually needs them, with reproducible integrity and reuse.
hard_constraints: input security must exist exactly once in frozen Primary Locator Inventory
materialized bytes must come from an approved official CNInfo static origin
payload must be a valid PDF payload
raw bytes must be retained by the cache backend for the consuming scope
SHA256 must be recorded and revalidated before reuse
materialization must not alter Primary selection
historical post-PIT observation cannot be relabeled prospective
soft_constraints_removed: store all PDFs in Git history
install a browser merely to fetch a static PDF when direct static-origin HTTP works
bind the Evidence contract permanently to one cache storage product

search_order_applied.Avoid: Static file retrieval does not require exchange announcement-page navigation.
search_order_applied.Absorb: Frozen locator inventory owns document selection; materializer only resolves locator to bytes.
search_order_applied.Substitute: Git stores receipts/indexes; raw-byte cache backend is pluggable.
search_order_applied.Precompute_Reuse: Content-addressed SHA256 object reused after integrity validation.
search_order_applied.Optimize: Network retry tuning is not part of V2.7.30 unless the minimal direct path proves necessary.

validation_scope.purpose: contract validation only; not a stock recommendation or ranking
